gloss: not fully convinced; not satisfied; still having doubts

definitions.gloss: not fully convinced; unconvinced; not satisfied; still having doubts
definitions.explanation: A feeling of lingering doubt or dissatisfaction, even after receiving an explanation. Something doesn't quite sit right.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{説明|せつめい}には{釈然|しゃくぜん}としない。
examples.english: I'm not fully convinced by his explanation.

examples.japanese: {謝|あやま}られたが、{釈然|しゃくぜん}としない{気持|きも}ちが{残|のこ}る。
examples.english: I was apologized to, but a feeling of dissatisfaction lingers.

examples.japanese: {判決|はんけつ}の{理由|りゆう}を{聞|き}いても、{釈然|しゃくぜん}としないものがある。
examples.english: Even after hearing the reasons for the verdict, something doesn't sit right.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the negative form としない. The positive form {釈然|しゃくぜん}とする (to be fully convinced) exists but is rare. Expresses an intellectual or emotional unease that persists despite apparent resolution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釈然|しゃくぜん}としない{思|おも}い (a feeling of being unconvinced)
- {釈然|しゃくぜん}としない{点|てん} (an unconvincing point)
- どうも{釈然|しゃくぜん}としない (something just doesn't add up)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない: to not make sense, to be unconvincing — similar but focuses on logic
- {納得|なっとく}できない: cannot accept/agree — more straightforward disagreement
